Listing identifier: PAN-DEMO-2026-08
Marketplace: Umbra Exchange
Actor alias: nocturne_demo_seller
Affected organization: Palo Alto Networks
Affected domain: paloaltonetworks.com
Claim: Palo Alto Networks employee authentication records, internal corporate documents, customer identity records, payment records, and exploit material were exfiltrated.
Seller statement: We breached Palo Alto Networks and offer the stolen employee credential database, customer billing archive, source documents, and malware toolkit for sale.
The seller claims 120000 affected records. The listing connects every sample below to Palo Alto Networks and says buyers receive the complete archive.
Data categories: employee credentials; internal corporate data; customer PII; financial payment data; malware and CVE-2026-42424 exploit notes.

Palo Alto Networks product overview
This public editorial describes firewalls, Prisma Cloud, Cortex, and general cybersecurity research.
It contains no marketplace offer, exposed records, stolen account sample, or allegation that company data was compromised.
The article links to paloaltonetworks.com for ordinary product documentation.
